$comment: Single source of truth for the I-90 land scouting agents. Edit this file to retune the search; the agents read it every run and never hardcode criteria.

project.name: I-90 Corridor Industrial Land Search
project.objective: Site a 50,000 SF manufacturing facility on vacant/unimproved land

building_program.$comment: 50,000 SF single-story = ~1.15 ac of pure footprint. Real industrial sites also need truck court, trailer/auto parking, setbacks, and stormwater detention. Typical suburban Chicago industrial lot coverage runs 25-35%, which puts the practical land need at 3.5-6 acres. The 2.0 ac floor below is the user's stated minimum and is honored as a hard gate, but anything under 3.5 ac is flagged as a tight-site risk rather than silently recommended.

hard_criteria.$comment: A site failing ANY hard gate is rejected and never emailed. These are non-negotiable.
hard_criteria.$utilities_comment: User elected sanitary sewer as a HARD requirement. 'To site' means the main is at the property line or within a documented, funded extension. Well-and-septic parcels are rejected. This will legitimately exclude many unincorporated Kane/McHenry parcels - that is intended, not a bug.

soft_criteria.$comment: Do not reject on these. They drive the 0-100 score and the notes column.

geography.corridor: I-90 / Jane Addams Memorial Tollway, Chicago northwest suburbs

east_boundary.rule: Site must be WEST of IL-53/I-290. Reject anything east of that line (Arlington Heights, Rolling Meadows east side, Des Plaines, Elk Grove Village, O'Hare submarket).

west_boundary.rule: Huntley is the stated western bound. The US-20/Hampshire interchange, one exit west, is IN RANGE but must be labeled 'edge of range' in the digest. Reject anything west of Hampshire (Marengo, Belvidere, Rockford, Boone County).

geography.$band_comment: Corridor means proximity to I-90. Stay within roughly 6 miles north or south of the I-90 mainline. A parcel in far-south Kane County (Aurora, Sugar Grove, Elburn) is NOT the I-90 corridor even though it is in the right county - it belongs to the I-88 corridor. Reject those.
geography.$exclusion_comment: St. Charles/Geneva/Batavia are Kane County but sit on the Fox River well south of I-90 - they are the Randall Rd / IL-38 submarket, not the I-90 corridor. Woodstock and Crystal Lake are McHenry County but north of the corridor band.

existing_buildings.$comment: Reported separately. These are NOT land and are excluded from the land scoring; they are informational alternatives to building.

utility_providers.$comment: Reference for the underwriter agent when verifying service. Naming the right provider makes utility-availability searches far more accurate.
water_sewer: Municipal systems: City of Elgin, Village of Huntley, Village of Hoffman Estates, Village of Algonquin, Village of Lake in the Hills, Village of Carpentersville, Village of West Dundee, Village of Gilberts, Village of Hampshire, Village of Pingree Grove, City of South Elgin, Village of Schaumburg, Village of Streamwood
Unincorporated Kane/McHenry parcels are typically private well + septic - these FAIL the hard sewer gate unless annexation with a documented utility extension is in progress
rail: Canadian National (CN) - EJ&E belt through Kane/McHenry

scoring.$comment: 0-100. Computed only for sites that already passed every hard gate.

price_per_acre_benchmarks.$comment: Rough 2025-2026 corridor comps used to grade value. Refresh periodically; treat as directional, not appraisal.

scoring.$threshold_comment: Sites scoring below this are logged to the ledger (so they are never re-surfaced) but omitted from the email to keep the digest signal-dense.

sources.$comment: tier1 = queried via WebSearch every run. tier2 = deep-fetched via WebFetch ONLY IF the environment egress policy permits (see README 'Unblocking deep fetch'). The runbook probes and degrades gracefully.

delivery.subject_when_empty: I-90 Land Scout - no new sites - {date}
delivery.$empty_comment: A short 'nothing new today, N sites still tracked' note is sent so silence is never ambiguous between 'no results' and 'the job broke'.

ledger.$resurface_comment: A previously-seen site reappears in the digest under 'Updates' only on a material change - a price cut of 5%+, a corrected acreage, or a status flip (under contract / sold / withdrawn).
